   - Place the chiles directly over a gas stove burner or under a high heat broiler (if using an oven, set the broiler to high).

   - After a few minutes, gently peel off the charred skin. If any stubborn areas remain, you can use a paper towel to gently rub off any remaining skin.

   - You can continue to cook the chiles in the pan with oil, as you would with bell peppers, or you can stuff them directly at this point and continue cooking until tender.
